name: Transfer of Certified Disciplinary Record
description: Certified copy of a transferring student's disciplinary record sent to the receiving district on request.
deadline: within ten (10) days from receipt of the request
quote: In the case of student transfers from the District, the District shall send to the receiving district, upon request, a certified copy of the student's disciplinary record within ten (10) days from receipt of the request to supply this record.
